question: Draft the AWS EA counter-proposal brief for Marcus

intro.title: Priya's control tower
intro.text: Priya Nair runs Mediacorp procurement — $92.2M of managed spend. This morning her workspace opens as a control tower, and askMElah is already on shift.

hero.title: Blips on the renewal radar
hero.text: A 90-day radar sweeps 23 renewals — AWS's $12.0M blip glows hot at 53 days — while the priority panel counts down to Monday's counter, ask fixed at 14%.

kpis.title: Four dials, no chrome
kpis.text: The naked stat strip: $92.2M managed spend, $6.6M savings running $410K ahead, cycle time down to 6.4 days, 23 renewals inside the window.

chart.title: Three systems, one warning
chart.text: The full-bleed Leverage chapter joins SAP, ServiceNow and DocuSign: vendor incidents up 63% since May at vendors holding $18.9M in expiring contracts. Instant negotiating ammunition.

ask.title: Drag a blip, ask away
ask.text: Priya drags the AWS blip straight off the radar into chat and asks askMElah for the counter-proposal brief — Marcus Webb's number, due Monday.

delegate.title: Hand askMElah the chase
delegate.text: In The Chase, one Delegate click sends askMElah after the Dell block: $8,790 overcharge proven against Amendment 3, corrected invoice committed by August 15.

crew.title: Hawk works the room
crew.text: The Crew opens on a tiny office: Priya's agent Hawk carries the Dell chase to the askMElah hub, Tally checks the math, Clause reads Amendment 3, and Hawk walks the answer back to her desk.

autopilot.title: Strips clear themselves
autopilot.text: Clear the Queue lays approvals out as flight strips — $486,300 awaiting clearance. Flip Autopilot and routine strips stamp CLEARED; Databricks and Adobe still need Priya.

mcp.title: Ground systems, all answering
mcp.text: The footer rail lights the tower's ground systems — Ariba, SAP, DocuSign, eight live connections — with the MCP console one click away.

recap.title: The week on the board
recap.text: The Week chapter tallies tower hours — 16.5 in meetings, 11 in focus — beside five open work orders. One button drafts the end-of-week recap.

outro.title: Priya flies. askMElah sweeps.
outro.text: The radar keeps sweeping and the strips keep clearing. Priya's hours went to the $12.0M AWS deal — the tower handled everything else.
